description: This file is a shell script used to test the handling of ambiguous refs in a Git repository, including setup of refs, checkout operations, and verification of warnings and messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message and file (implied).

methods.name: git
methods.description: Performs Git commands, such as branch creation, checkout, and tag creation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the given input, used for verifying output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisite conditions for subsequent tests.
